top_signals.title: Russian cloud firm Beget rebuilds from scratch after data wiper attack
top_signals.summary: A data-wiping malware attack has forced Russian cloud services provider Beget to rebuild its cloud infrastructure from scratch, the company said. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Dutch firm Optics11 in talks with navies on secretive underwater listening tech
top_signals.summary: For underwater use, the company’s fiber-optic sensing can detect an oil tanker at 100 kilometers, the CEO said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: High-Level Platform meets in Moldova to strengthen digital connectivity between the EU, the Black Sea region, South-Caucasus and Central Asia*
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Chișinău, 09 Nov 2026 Today, the first High-Level Connectivity Platform Meeting on Digital takes place in Chișinău, Moldova, jointly hosted by the European Commission and the Moldovan Ministry of Economic Development and Digitalisation. The meeting sets the groundwork for stronger digital connectivity between Europe and Centra Asia, via Moldova, in the form of an Integrated EU Secure Connectivity Offer.
